entities.summary: Linyon Demokratik Seselwa is a liberal political coalition which has governed from 2020 to 2025 in the Seychelles. Their coalition was originally made up of the four main opposition parties: the Seychelles National Party (SNP) led by Wavel Ramkalawan, the Seychellois Alliance (LS) led by Patrick Pillay, the Seychelles Party for Social Justice and Democracy led by Alexia Amesbury and the Seychelles United Party led by Robert Ernesta. The Seychellois Alliance left the coalition in February 2018 after the resignation of their leader Patrick Pillay as speaker and member of the National Assembly in January 2018.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Linyon Demokratik Seselwa coalition's governance from 2020 to 2025 had a significant impact on Seychelles' political landscape, marking the first time a liberal government was in power. The coalition's leadership and policies influenced the country's economic development and social reforms.
